_comment: The wrapper's configuration. Two things here are deliberate and both are
review-relevant: webDir points at the BUILT ASSETS so the app ships them
in its bundle rather than loading a URL (see README.md, guideline 4.2),
and there is no 'server' block at all - adding one turns this back into a
backgroundColor is the night ground from src/ui/tokens.css. It has to match
or a white frame flashes between the launch screen and the first paint.
contentInset is 'never' (Capacitor's default) since 1.8.9. It was 'always',
which makes the native scroll view inset the page by the safe areas itself:
the page then stopped short of the home indicator and the web view's own
dark backgroundColor showed as a band under the title screen (owner, iOS 26
Simulator). index.html asks for viewport-fit=cover and theme.css pads every
edge with the --safe-area-inset-* tokens, the same as the Android shell, so
the page draws to the glass and keeps its own content clear of the bars.
